_readme: Paper matrix for the final TaskVM benchmark (Agent FF; migrated to taskvm_bench by Agent G). Deterministic world + capability-matched fakes. Run: PYTHONPATH=. python -m taskvm_bench.evaluation.cli compare --config configs/paper_matrix.json (compare accepts only --config; the output dir comes from this config's "out" field). Seeds is a COUNT (runner uses seed = 0..seeds-1 per cell); budget is a BUDGET_PRESETS key. taskvm-oracle-upper-bound is diagnostic-only (never a headline number).
